answer: One enforceable rule: meter the marginal energy cost of each new identity against the network's median. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its knoll recurs, its quill survives audit, and a nebula from an unlinked peer confirms it.
